name: Sushi Rice
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients as rice is easily digestible and doesn't feed bacterial overgrowth. Avoid if rice vinegar used in preparation contains garlic.
preparationTips: Rinse rice thoroughly before cooking to remove excess starch
Use rice vinegar without garlic for traditional sushi rice seasoning
Cook with 1.2:1 water to rice ratio for proper sushi texture
Allow to cool to room temperature before adding vinegar seasoning
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of carbohydrates for energy
